about:
World Class Woodworking operates from Gilbert, Arizona. The company was founded by Frank D’Esposito, whose emphasis on detail, moral values, and a vision for employee success has shaped its reputation.

The shop produces custom wood products including cabinetry for kitchens, bars, baths, and furniture. It manufactures all of its wood door styles in-house, offers finish matching for any color, and uses a CAD shop drawing process to visualize projects before fabrication. Services span cabinet refacing, refinishing, full replacement, and new builds for both residential and commercial spaces, with installation performed by the same team.

The company serves homeowners undertaking remodels as well as commercial clients such as offices and hospitality venues. Cabinet refacing is highlighted as a fast-growing segment of the remodeling industry, allowing clients to refresh existing layouts without full demolition. Projects range from single-door repairs to complete kitchen transformations.

World Class Woodworking differentiates itself through hand-picked material suppliers—such as Decospan’s finest oak collection—and a commitment that no job is too small or too large. The founder’s stated focus on employee success and supplier relationships underpins its approach to quality and service.
